clause: Per-region fill rule + paint-bucket region operation [STU-VEC-004]

scope.summary: Implement explicit per-contour/per-region fill rule (non-zero-winding | even-odd) on StudioVectorPath and per-region fill state on StudioVectorNetwork so one vector layer may hold filled and unfilled regions independently, plus a paint-bucket region command that fills or clears one enclosed network region without altering network topology.
acceptance_criteria: explicit per-region fill rule + non-topology-altering paint-bucket region op
expected_tests: test: even-odd vs winding resolution; per-region fill independence; paint-bucket fills/clears one region and leaves topology byte-identical

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: No fill-rule/region model; holes and multi-region fills render wrong.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
